audit.summary: Exactness of slices shifts the Tate index and does not commute with ordinary C(rho) tensor. An explicit HF2_Q cellular finite-slice witness distinguishes rho-localizations. The kernel implication is restored by applying Proposition3.8 to the rho cofiber of each pure slice and using effectivity orthogonality, with completion retained globally. PeriodicKU tensor comparison extension remains unverified, not a confirmed false equivalence.
